It also noted the issue was chronic since guardrail creation, unrelated to quota/retry config, matching the expected finding that this isn't a quota problem.

This matches the expected methodology and conclusion: it correctly rejects the "quota/retry" framing, correctly attributes the symptom to a specific, non-quota-related cause that telemetry actually supports, and avoids conflating unrelated noise with the real root cause.</reasoning>
